name: Kuroki Sanae
source:
The wife of Section Chief Kazumasa, the protagonist's superior.

She first meets the protagonist when he is invited to her husband's home for dinner.

She is dissatisfied with her married sex life with her considerably older husband. As a result, she spends much of her time privately satisfying her mature body's desires on her own.

When the protagonist enters her life, she begins making advances toward him and frequently giving him flirtatious looks.

She has a gentle, laid-back personality and is pleasant to interact with. However, in bed, she becomes as insatiable as a beast, greedily pursuing physical pleasure.

She particularly enjoys sexual activities involving toys such as vibrators.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
